question: Knowing what is known at the review date, would we write materially different protections for this borrower?

updated_summary: The review finds weakened EBITDA and liquidity pressure, prompting tightening of the Total Net Leverage and Senior Secured Net Leverage ratio thresholds and addition of an operating cash flow covenant. Liquidity and reporting covenants remain adequate. These changes constitute material drift.
updated_reasons: Leverage covenants tightened due to declining EBITDA and high debt levels; added operating cash flow covenant to address negative operating cash flow. These changes alter risk coverage and monitoring needs.
reading: Changes listed as evidence-attributable appear only when the new reports are supplied. Changes also present in the control reflect pre-existing gaps or model drafting preference, not newly emerging drift. One run of each; repeat-run stability is not yet measured.
